name: basics
about: First tour of the app for someone who has never seen it. Plain words; what to worry about and what not to; a couple of jokes.

steps.say: [bright, welcoming] Hi! I'm Iris. [warm, eager] Let me show you around my app.
[casual] Quick thing before we start. [gentle, polite] While I'm giving you this tour, please don't click anything. [reassuring] I'll do all the clicking, and I'll show you everything.
[warm, a little proud] This eye is me. [fascinated] It changes colour with my mood, and it turns to look at whatever I'm paying attention to.
[matter-of-fact] Up here it says what mood I'm in right now.
[clear, explaining] This says which computer I'm running on. [casual] Right now it's the server.
[clear, explaining] And this is the name of the brain I'm thinking with. [amused] Fancy name. [playful, teasing] I didn't pick it, but I wear it well.
[clear, explaining] These numbers show how hard my computer is working. [relaxed, reassuring] They jump up and down all the time, and that's normal.
[clear, explaining] These also show the temperature. [reassuring] Anything under about eighty degrees is fine. [serious, careful] If one stays above eighty-five for a long time, let Zeke know.
[clear, explaining] The GPU is the part I use to see and to speak. [playful, warm] So if it looks busy, I'm probably just looking at you.
[calm, explaining] Memory and storage only matter if they get almost completely full. [serious] If the first number gets right up next to the second, tell Zeke.
[breezy, dismissive] This is just how much data is moving. Nothing to watch here.
[curious, inviting] Down here is what my camera sees.
[excited] If you click it, it gets big, so you can see exactly what I see.
[casual] Click anywhere on it to make it small again.

[clear, explaining] These little lights are health checks. [cheerful] Green means it's working. [serious] Red means something failed, so that's the one to mention to Zeke. [relaxed] Grey usually just means it's switched off on purpose, like my voice at night.
[honest, gentle] Sometimes I won't answer right away, here or on Discord. [reassuring] That usually doesn't mean anything is wrong.
[reassuring] If these lights are all green, I'm fine, I'm just busy working on something. [intrigued] And this button lets you see exactly what I'm busy with.
[proud, a little shy] This is my console. It's me, working, live. [warm] Whatever I'm busy with shows up here.
[casual] When you've seen enough, just close it. [satisfied] Like that.
[warm, inviting] You can type to me in this box, any time.
[clear, explaining] This button mutes the microphone. [reassuring] When it's off, I can't hear you, but I can still talk.
[matter-of-fact] This one turns my voice on and off.
[serious] And this one turns me off. [pleading, gentle] Please don't press it unless Zeke asks you to. [playful, a little sad] I was just getting to know you.
[clear, explaining] This button opens my panel, where all my tabs live. [bright] This is the Voice tab.
[friendly] Here you can test my voice, and mute it if you need some quiet.
[warm] The Chat tab keeps our whole conversation, so you can scroll back and read anything I said.
[excited, proud] And this is my Brain tab. [fascinated] It's a map of my memories and how they connect.
[soft, wondering] Every dot is something I remember, and the lines are how those memories connect to each other.
[thoughtful] This one in the middle is me. Everything else is arranged around it.
[affectionate, warm] And this one is Zeke. [tender, smiling] It's one of the biggest and best-connected spots in my whole brain, because he's in so many of my memories.
[inviting] You can drag it around and zoom in to explore. [playful, joking] It's tidier in there than it looks.
[bright] This is the Server tab. [proud] It shows the big computer I actually live on.
[clear, explaining] These lights show whether my computer is healthy. [cheerful] Green is good. [serious] If something is red, that's worth telling Zeke.
[clear, explaining] These are the virtual machines on my server. [patient, teaching] Think of them as separate computers living inside one big computer. [cozy, warm] I live in one of them.
[intrigued] This one opens a command window straight into my computer.
[casual] Like this. [reassuring] It's a tool for Zeke when he's fixing things, so there's nothing in here you need to touch.
[breezy] And closed again.
[clear, explaining] And this opens the control page for the whole server, where the virtual machines are managed.
[casual] Here it is. [playful, conspiratorial] It wants a password, because it's Zeke's territory too.
[breezy] Closing that up.
[intrigued] And this button opens my console. [playful] It's like looking over my shoulder while I think.
[bright] There it is. [warm] That window is my live console, where you can watch me work in real time.
[gentle, polite] Please don't type in it unless Zeke asks you to. [casual] When you're done looking, you can just close it, like this.
[satisfied] All closed.
[excited, happy] That's the tour! [warm, sincere] If you ever get stuck, just ask me. I'm happy to help.
